objective: Quantify which statistical components reduce the paid physical archive cost of Shared, using a dataset-level ablation with exact recovery and a component ledger.
hypothesis: Under one frozen Shared codec and identical canonical inputs, disabling support modeling, positive-value modeling, spatial context, or parameter sharing increases complete archive bytes; the magnitude of each increase is a component contribution, while interactions are reported separately.
null_hypothesis: At least one disable arm does not increase complete archive bytes, or the observed differences cannot be attributed to the named component after charging model, graph, metadata, and framing bytes.
inference_unit: one complete exposed HEST development slice; pilot uses INT17, MEND124, and MEND140, with expansion only after the vertical-slice gate
primary_endpoint: complete physical archive bytes per dataset, including all serialized model, graph, metadata, framing, support, and value members

arms.description: Production Shared K32 with support M_s=6, value context M_v=6, frozen B_s=16, ORIGINAL order, and all current model/sharing components.
Support is still coded, but its context-conditioned P(S|q,C) correction is disabled; support probabilities are gene-only and no support graph odds are paid.
Support branch remains active; positive values are encoded with a fixed-width lossless positive-integer stream, with no fitted positive-value CDF, tail model, or value context model.
All spatial predecessors are removed from both support and positive-value contexts; the remaining gene/value models are refit and all inactive graph members are omitted or explicitly accounted for.

Spatial context and support/value factorization remain active, but the q1 Bernoulli parameter is fit and serialized independently per gene; the fixed eight tail classes remain unchanged. This is the preregistered q1-sharing ablation, not a claim that every tail histogram is independently fit.

planned_contrasts: two-way interaction residuals; no additive decomposition is assumed
frozen_components: K32 value grouping unless the arm definition explicitly removes sharing
rANS backend where an arm retains entropy coding
allowed_changes: arm-specific model members required by the preregistered definitions
acceptance: synthetic exact roundtrip for every arm
one complete-slice smoke exact roundtrip for every arm
physical ledger sums exactly to archive size
fresh-process reproduction for the full arm and at least one disable arm
failed or incomplete arms retained and excluded rather than patched post hoc
pilot_gate: Do not expand beyond the three exposed pilot slices until every arm has a defined archive format, exact decode, and auditable physical ledger.
